Patch 1.2.7

Hey everyone, here are the notes for the week. It's a tiny patch as basically all of our focus was put on 1.3. Hoping to share good news soon!

  • Hanure the Berserker has been nerfed slightly. The main changes revolve around its permanent health regen being reduced, the range and number of Ruins being reduced, and the cooldown of Ruins being increased
  • Special Lunafrosts have been added, granting the Dimensional Destroyer buff in dungeons
  • The announcement for rare Sunfish pools is now worldwide

== Patch 1.2.7 ==

Hey everyone, here are the notes for the week. It's a tiny patch as basically all of our focus was put on 1.3. Hoping to share good news soon!

* Hanure the Berserker has been nerfed slightly. The main changes revolve around its permanent health regen being reduced, the range and number of Ruins being reduced, and the cooldown of Ruins being increased
* Special Lunafrosts have been added, granting the Dimensional Destroyer buff in dungeons
* The announcement for rare Sunfish pools is now worldwide
